title: Mol's Eyepatch

sources.title: Find Mol
markers: obtaining the eyepatch will unlock the questline

summary: Pick up Mol’s eyepatch to update Find Mol and award Urchin Inspiration.

fields.Quest use: Picking it up advances Find Mol, and can start the quest if Isobel was not saved. Urchins gain Amateur Optician. The eyepatch can be returned to Mol at the Guildhall.
fields.Acquisition: Balthazar’s Necrotic Laboratory in the Mind Flayer Colony.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
